blocks.text: THE SCRIPTURES MENTION— write the vision, make it plain! “Though it tarry it shall not lie; it shall come to pass!” — A multitude of prophecy has already occurred, and more is yet to be fulfilled. And this is the latter times! According to the evidence since Israel went home we are getting closer to the end of the last Jubilee! Jesus said in Matt. 24:33-34, “So like wise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors. Verily I say unto you. This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.”

GOD’S PROPHETIC CLOCK IS TICKING— The countdown is here! Some of these Scriptures are already fulfilling, others will take Place in different time measures just ahead one sequence after another! — “In my opinion in this century or closing generation! — “Watch! Be ye also ready!” — In James 5:3 we see some of this already taking place outwardly and the rest is being cleverly done underneath! And it says for the last days... Now this next Scripture has been fulfilled almost completely. There is still yet to be a flash fire of restoration to the elect. And it will be done dramatically and swiftly! — Vrs. 7-8, Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain. Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

AND THIS NEXT SCRIPTURE— is literally starting to be fulfilled before our eyes. Dan. 9:27, And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate. — “And the prince that shall come shall soon be unveiled in this century!”

THIS YEAR (1994)— has been a celestial year just as predicted! And including the coming of 5 Comets. — Four have already past according to scientist! — “Also this fall will be a great solar eclipse.” — Jesus said, that these type of signs would take place during the latter time of our age concerning these events! — Now in July all of the news reported the great asteroid that bombarded Jupiter. — “This is warning the earth that it soon also will be visited by great meteorite fireballs! — “And I have already given my opinion as to its fulfillment. Rev. 8:7-8, The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up. And the second angel sounded, and as it were @ great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood; Note: According to the Scripts we will see some events even before these above Scriptures conclude!

THE FOUR HORSES OF THE APOCALYPSE— is beginning to step forth and they will come in their own time phase! — The White horse rider is alive and will be unveiled as we spoke above! — “And before or by the crossing of this century the rest including the chemical, fiery yet cold pale horse of death shall leave destruction in its wake!” — (Rev. 6:1-8) Vr. 8 — And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth. — Famine, pestilence and disease shall increase and greater starvation shall set in the latter part of this decade. — “Jesus is alerting the earth, but they are not listening so well!” — The Scripts predicted all of this 20 years, or so ago! — “There shall be an upsurge of mighty quakes across every part of this earth! Plus society and unexpected social changes will be unbelievable if one should tell what is yet to appear!” — Also the California great quake should take place years before this century ends in my opinion! “Plus the Western section of the United States shall be severely judged also! The shock waves and damages shall reach even southward and northward. Some of our beautiful cities shall be wiped out soon by various type destructions!”

THE WEATHER— will change first one way and then another way. It will be the worst ever of the centuries! The four elements shall ravage this planet. “Earth, fire, wind and water!” — I foresee mammoth storms and great winds, heatwaves and chilling cold will
also have its way! — “The planet is groaning and travailing because God's people will soon be leaving!”

1994 HAS BEEN A CLIMATIC YEAR— as the Scripts predicted and will end likewise, and on into ’95-96 more world crises arrive involving government, earth and its population! We might say also that immorality has reached the stages as predicted and shall be twice as bad before century ends! — “Government, apostasy and Babylon shall seduce this planet into a fantasy world of sin, wickedness and debauchery!” — After various crises, false peace shall come, but it will later blow out into an atomic firestorm! — “Behold, saith the Lord, It is later than you know. For I cometh in an hour that ye think not.”

THESE SCRIPTURES is truly beginning to occur. (Matt. 25:1-10) Vr 6 And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him. It seems that these Scriptures are coming as a snare upon the religious organizations of our age! — “Soon the door of the Translation shall be closing!”

ACCORDING TO PROPHECY— and not too many years hence, about the time Israel finishes its last Jubilee, China and Gog will come out of the East and North invading Israel like the locusts crossing the mountain! (Ezek. chap. 38 — Rev. 16:12) — Modern dams and droughts and a highway down from China makes this possible.

AN ATOMIC WAR— will definitely take place in our generation! — New energy weapons from space and the sea will be used! — Isa. 24:6, Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left. — “Through the prophetic gift I foresee some of the most unusual signs will be given from the heavens several years in advance before this catastrophe!”

FIERY HOLOCAUST— Around the ending of the century evidently Rome will be destroyed. And as the Scripts foretold the Vatican will be burnt with fire! Evidently this is prophesied in Rev. 17:16-18 by the 10 Kings as the whore who rides the beast is wiped out!

IN A TWINKLING OF AN EYE— Could the Church be translated in this century and still have time for the Battle of Armageddon? — Yes, my opinion is that it could; anytime between now and the next few years. — “Evidently the elect leave right in the midst of the Tribulation just before the mark!” — Still leaving room for the Battle of Armageddon to be over by the ending of 2001. — They have a Jewish Covenant almost completed, and just needing to be confirmed by a false prince! — “This is no time to sleep it could even be quicker than we think! — “Let every day count, watch and pray so the Holy Spirit can keep you sealed in! Let’s get the gospel out quickly!” (Read first paragraph of Scroll #105) — Will give
